modelling_convention.disclosure: d1886 modelling convention, 23 October 2026. Microcosm allocates Census counts with unstated household size across stated size categories in proportion to their stated counts, assuming missing at random. Each region's computed residual is its independently published household total minus its stated leaves. The national size calculation is 61,725 households; regional calculations sum to 61,713. Tenure uses the same proportional convention: the national difference is 426 and regional differences sum to 429. These regional differences and allocated leaves are Microcosm calculations, not Stats NZ published residual cells or allocated estimates. The sensitivity allocates size residuals only to one- and two-person households in their stated proportions. Fractional targets are retained. Allocation precedes one application of B2 ERP growth. Region 99 remains separate and uses the disclosed national-growth proxy.
